extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: ground-mounted solar array: three 1.0 x 1.7 m modules (portrait) on a 25 degree steel rack, approx. 3.1 x 1.6 x 1.3 m
extras.notes: each module: 6 x 10 dark blue cells with light gaps (white backsheet), aluminium frame with clamps; two purlins on two inclined rails, four posts on small concrete footings, diagonal braces; junction boxes and cable bows on the back; panels face -Y (tilted towards the front); no moving parts; no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
